Manufar sirri

Abin da OpenCADIrrigation ke ajiyewa, abin da yake aikawa da kuma ga wa, cikin kalmomi masu sauƙi.

Wanda ke da alhaki

Mai kula da OpenCADIrrigation ne ke wallafa gidan yanar gizon opencadirrigation.com da manhajar OpenCADIrrigation, kuma shi ne mai sarrafa bayanan sirrin da aka bayyana a wannan shafi.

Tuntuɓa: buɗe batu (issue) a ma'ajiyar lambar aikin (github.com/videjunior/opencadirrigation/issues). Don batun da bai kamata ya zama na jama'a ba, nemi hanyar sadarwa ta sirri a can, ba tare da rubuta bayanan sirri a batun ba.

A taƙaice

  • Babu asusu kuma babu sabar OpenCADIrrigation a bayan manhajar: ayyuka, ajiya ta atomatik, sigogi, tattaunawar AI, maɓallai da zaɓuɓɓuka suna zama a mai binciken gizonka da kuma a fayilolin da kake ajiyewa.
  • Ƙididdigar ziyara (Google Analytics) tana aiki a dukkan shafukan gidan yanar gizon da kuma a cikin manhajar, tare da cookies ɗinta; kana iya kashe ta da Saitunan cookies, a ƙasan shafukan.
  • Sabis ɗin da manhajar ke amfani da su don haruffa, taswirori, ƙasa, yanayi, binciken adireshi da mataimakin AI suna karɓar buƙatunka kai tsaye daga mai binciken gizonka idan ka yi amfani da su.

Abin da ke zama a na'urarka

Ajiya ta atomatik, ayyukan kwanan nan, sigogi 10 na ƙarshe na kowane aiki, tattaunawar AI 24 mafi kwanan nan (tare da hotunansu da ƙananan fayilolin da aka haɗa), maɓallan API da ka zaɓa a tuna, maɓallin Google Maps, harshen fuskar manhaja, jigo da sauran zaɓuɓɓuka ana ajiye su a ma'ajiyar mai binciken gizonka (localStorage da IndexedDB), kuma kwafin manhajar a cache ɗinsa, don ta buɗe ba tare da intanet ba. Babu wani da ke karɓar su, kuma ba mu da kwafi.

Suna nan har sai ka share su: Ajiye tattaunawa a wannan mai binciken, a saitunan mataimakin, yana kashe tattaunawa kuma yana share su, kuma share bayanan gidan yanar gizon a mai binciken gizo yana share komai. Mai binciken gizo ma na iya share su da kansa idan sarari ya yi ƙaranci ko, a Safari, bayan wasu makonni ba tare da ziyara ba, don haka ka ajiye ayyukanka a matsayin fayilolin .oci.json.

Hanyar haɗin rabawa tana ɗauke da aikin a cikin adireshin, bayan alamar #, wadda masu binciken gizo ba sa aikawa ga kowace sabar.

Ƙididdigar ziyara da cookies

Dukkan shafukan gidan yanar gizon da manhajar suna loda Google Analytics 4, wanda ke saita cookies _ga da _ga_<id> (suna ɗorewa har zuwa shekaru biyu) kuma yana yin rikodin shafukan da aka kalla da kowane buɗe manhajar, lokacin ziyarar, shafin da ya kawo ka, nau'in na'ura da na mai binciken gizo, girman allo, harshe da kusan wurin da kake wanda Google ke samu daga adireshin IP (Google Analytics 4 ba ya ajiye adireshin IP). Google Analytics ba ya taɓa karɓar sashen adireshin da ke bayan alamar #, inda hanyar haɗin rabawa ke ɗauke da aikin, kuma an kashe fasalolinsa na talla.

Manufa: sanin mutane nawa ke ziyartar gidan yanar gizon da amfani da manhajar, da waɗanne shafuka da harsuna suke amfani da su, don inganta su. Tushen doka: halattacciyar buƙatar auna amfanin sabis na kyauta. Ana riƙe bayanan har tsawon lokacin riƙewa da aka saita a Google Analytics, watanni 14 a mafi yawa.

Kana iya ƙin wannan sarrafawa a kowane lokaci da Saitunan cookies, a ƙasan shafukan: idan ka ƙi, ana share cookies na ƙididdiga na gidan yanar gizon kuma ba za a ƙara loda Google Analytics a wannan mai binciken gizon ba. Toshe cookies ko rubutun shirin (script) a mai binciken gizonka ma yana hana shi aiki.

Ƙididdigar tana aiki kuma yayin da manhajar ke buɗe, a shafin da ke riƙe ayyukanka kuma, idan ka zaɓi a tuna su, maɓallanka na AI: kamar kowane rubutun shirin (script) na gidan yanar gizon, rubutun shirin Google Analytics zai iya karanta ma'ajiyar gidan yanar gizon a mai binciken gizonka, kuma yana aika wa Google bayanan da aka ambata a sama kaɗai. Google Analytics sabis ne na Google ƙarƙashin sharuɗɗansa da manufar sirrinsa, kuma ana iya sarrafa bayanan a Amurka da wasu ƙasashe.

Ɗaukar nauyin gidan yanar gizo (hosting)

Firebase Hosting (Google) ne ke ba da gidan yanar gizon, wanda ke karɓar adireshin IP da bayanan fasaha na kowace buƙata (adireshin da aka nema, mai binciken gizo, lokaci) don isar da shafuka da kare sabis ɗin. Tushen doka: halattacciyar buƙatar gudanar da gidan yanar gizon cikin aminci. Ba a amfani da waɗannan bayanai don wani abu dabam ba.

Manhajar da dukan haruffanta, har da na kowane rubutu da alama (Sinanci, Japananci, Larabci da rubuce-rubucen Indiya, kibiyoyi, emoji), suna fitowa daga wannan gidan yanar gizon ma: ba a tuntuɓar kowane sabis na haruffa.

Sabis ɗin da mai binciken gizonka ke tuntuɓa idan ka yi amfani da su

  • Taswirorin tushe: OpenStreetMap, OpenTopoMap, CARTO, Esri, Google (da maɓallinka) ko adireshin da ka saita suna karɓar adireshin IP da wurin taswirar da ke allo.
  • Tsayin ƙasa da yanayi daga intanet: Terrain Tiles (AWS Open Data), Open-Meteo, OpenTopoData da NASA POWER suna karɓar daidaitawar wurin, ba wani abu dabam na aikin ba.
  • Binciken adireshi: Nominatim (OpenStreetMap) yana karɓar adireshin da ka rubuta.
  • Kasidun da ake lodawa daga URL: sabar wannan adireshin.
  • Mataimakin AI (na zaɓi): Anthropic ko OpenAI, da maɓallinka. Ba a aika komai kafin ka danna Aika; sannan ana aika saƙonka, fayilolin da ka haɗa, bayanan aikin da ka yi wa alama, saƙonnin da suka gabata kuma, yayin da yake aiki, sakamakon kayan aikin da yake amfani da su, har da hotunan zane. Yarjejeniyarka da wannan kamfani ce ke tafiyar da abin da yake yi da su, kuma yana caji asusunka.
  • Faɗar da baki: gane murya na mai binciken gizo yana aika sautin ga kamfanin da ya ƙera mai binciken (Google a Chrome, Microsoft a Edge, Apple a Safari).

Kowane ɗayan waɗannan sabis yana da manufar sirrinsa kuma yana iya sarrafa bayanai a wajen ƙasarka.

Haƙƙoƙinka

Ƙarƙashin LGPD a Brazil, GDPR a Tarayyar Turai da Birtaniya, da dokoki makamantansu, kana iya neman tabbatarwa, samun dama, gyara, sharewa da bayani game da raba bayanan sirrinka, ka ƙi wani sarrafawa kuma ka janye amincewarka.

Ba mu riƙe bayanan da ke bayyana ko kai wane ne: ƙididdigar ba ta ɗauke da sunanka (pseudonymous), kuma duk sauran suna a mai binciken gizonka, ƙarƙashin ikonka. Don kowace buƙata, yi amfani da hanyar tuntuɓa da ke sama. Kana kuma iya kai ƙara ga hukumar kare bayanai ta ƙasarka (a Brazil, ANPD).

Canje-canje

Idan wannan manufa ta canza, kwanan watan da ke ƙasan shafin ma yana canzawa.

An sabunta a 2026-11-04

Gidan yanar gizon da manhajar suna ƙidaya ziyara da Google Analytics, wanda ke amfani da cookies. Idan ka ƙi, ba za a ƙara ƙidaya ziyararka a wannan mai binciken gizon ba. Manufar sirri
